Name: Satchels
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Satchels[/b] is a mod that adds items that hold more items. There are also cooking, crafting, and auto-pickup upgrades.

The satchels are purchased from Clint and require ore bars. Cooking upgrade from Gus, Crafting upgrade from Robin, and auto pickup upgrade from Krobus.

They work closer to Minecraft chests than Stardew chests - shift click to quick deposit/withdraw.

Art by fellowclown

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
